messages:
alex (PM): Heads-up — Acme pilot asks for private onramp with HSM/KMS, 50ms p95 for chat in peak, and dedicated capacity for predictable billing. Need to map cross-team deps and an acceptable launch bar.

matt (Eng-runtime): Re: latency — 50ms p95 is tight for long context. What max tokens/turns are they expecting? Also do they require current model (gptx-8k) or ok with a quantized variant?

alex (PM): They expect ~6000 token context worst-case, avg 512. Model preference: they'd like close-to-SOTA, but could accept a slightly smaller variant if it guarantees p95. Important: SLA + audit logs for data residency.

priya (Infra): HSM + VPC onramp is doable but needs lead time for cert + network peering. Estimate 4 weeks for infra prep, more if we need a dedicated colo path. Also: capacity reservations for Dedicated pools need commitment window.

sara (Security): On the HSM part we'll need an architecture review and KMS rotation policy in place. Also clarify: will customer-managed keys, or Redwood-hosted KMS w/ HSM export-protection? That affects timeline.

alex (PM): Customer-managed keys (they insist).

matt (Eng-runtime): Ok. For 6000 tokens at ~50ms p95 we'd need aggressive batching + KV cache warm paths and likely a lower precision quant configuration. I can prototype quantized-8bit variant but need infra to support it. Also: fallbacks — if dedicated pool overloaded should we route to hosted degraded model?

toni (Product Ops): Routing fallback -> we should surface to customer as a graceful degrade (higher latency or lower-quality model). Product will accept that with clear SLAs. Need agreement from SRE and sales.

jon (SRE): Fallback route is fine if we set capacity headroom and prewarm triggers. Prewarm policy: when customer sessions > X, spin up reserved slots. But autoscaling warm-up times depend on instance types. Suggest a prewarm window and a canary plan.

matt (Eng-runtime): +1 to canary. Propose canary policy config snippet for rollout:```yaml
canary: true
percent: 5
monitoring: [latency_p95, error_rate, cost_delta]
rollback_thresholds:
  latency_p95: +20% # relative
  error_rate: 0.5%
```

priya (Infra): That config looks fine. We need to know expected traffic profile to size dedicated pool and prewarm thresholds. Send customer traffic estimate.

alex (PM): I'll get traffic estimate today. Target go/no-go timeline goal: 6 weeks if security signoff + infra window align. If HSM provisioning slips, we fallback to Redwood-managed keys for pilot only (with consent).

sara (Security): We can accelerate review if we get a threat model and data flow doc. Also need proof of KMS integration test plan.

toni (Product Ops): Action items so far: 1) alex: share traffic + dataflow, 2) matt: prototype quantized pipeline and estimate perf delta, 3) priya: confirm infra lead time and exact network steps, 4) sara: list docs/tests required for signoff, 5) jon: draft canary + prewarm ops runbook.

alex (PM): Putting a short ownership matrix into the shared doc now. Also looping in sales for the commitment terms.

matt (Eng-runtime): Quick note — model fallback compatibility: if we route to a smaller variant we must ensure output schema/function-calls still compatible. I'll enumerate incompatibilities in the doc.

jon (SRE): Ops checklist preview: health endpoints, trace headers propagation, circuit-breaker on queue length, alert runbooks. Will add steps for manual scale and emergency rollback.

priya (Infra): I'll tentatively book infra prep slot week 3 after approval; details depend on HSM vendor lead time. If we have to get a colo path it's +2 weeks.

sara (Security): If customer-managed keys are mandatory, we should expect legal/KR review too. Bring legal in early.

toni (Product Ops): Can we agree on a soft launch bar: p95 <= 75ms, error_rate < 0.2%, audit logs delivered to customer S3 nightly, and HSM proofs for key usage? If devs hit that we proceed to GA contract discussion.

alex (PM): Soft launch bar agreed. I'll add to the doc and schedule a 30-min sync Friday to finalize triage.

deploy-bot: Scheduled meeting created: #onramp-pilot-sync Friday 12:30pm PST.

matt (Eng-runtime): I'll bring a 15-min perf demo. Priya, sara, jon — please bring any hard blockers.

sara (Security): I'll prioritize the threat model template so we can iterate before Friday.

alex (PM): Thanks all — posting link to the working doc in this thread: https://docs.internal.redwood/runway/onramp-acme (please comment directly).

toni (Product Ops): Noted. If anything changes before Friday ping me. :thumbsup:

jon (SRE): Adding a couple of alert thresholds now.

matt (Eng-runtime): Will prototype perf numbers by EOD Thursday and attach to doc.

alex (PM): Closing loop — main risk: HSM lead time and prewarm behavior at 6k tokens. We prioritize those two. Keeping this thread as canonical thread for deps.
